# Shree Krushi Thresher Works
> Multicrop, castor, groundnut and maize threshers made in Visnagar, Mehsana. Factory-direct, spare parts and service, crop-wise advice.

## Machines
- [Multicrop Thresher](https://www.example.com/en/products/multicrop-thresher/): One machine for many harvests. The all-rounder for mixed-crop farms.
- [Castor Thresher](https://www.example.com/en/products/castor-thresher/): Shells castor cleanly so seed stays whole and ready for the oil mill.
- [Groundnut Thresher](https://www.example.com/en/products/groundnut-thresher/): Strips pods from dried vines quickly and keeps the kernels intact.
- [Maize Thresher](https://www.example.com/en/products/maize-thresher/): Shells dried cobs in a single pass with an easy feed opening.
